target_reader: Server operators and site owners evaluating a VPS as an offsite or secondary backup target.
intent: Informational/commercial investigation: decide whether a VPS fits backup storage and how to size/design it.
existing_results_do_well: Cover storage capacity, encryption, retention and restore testing.
existing_results_miss: Clear distinction between a programmable VPS target and cheaper/durable object or dedicated storage.
Retention-driven sizing rather than current-dataset sizing.
Explicit connection to existing StealthRDP setup tutorial without duplicating it.
unique_value: A selection/design guide centered on failure domains, retention, bandwidth/restore windows, encryption and restore tests, with a clear 'when a VPS is not the right storage product' section.
commercial_connection: Reader can compare current NVMe/storage/bandwidth tiers only after deciding that a VPS is appropriate as the backup target.
cannibalization: New page owns selection/design; existing automated-backup article owns implementation.
existence_question: Why should vps-for-backups-storage exist when search already has competing results?
